notes: Word meanings read the way a learner would say them: 孩子 is child, 小朋友 is kid (little friend), 在 is at/in instead of 'to exist', 年 is year, and erhua words like 小孩儿 no longer show 'erhua variant of'. 235 HSK 1-3 words got a hand-written meaning, and word-bank cards that still show the old dictionary meaning update by themselves
